d: LOCATION: Frasers Suites Seef - Kingdom of Bahrain

d: CMA CGM Bahrain is staffed with knowledgeable and motivated industry professionals who work closely with customers to deliver tailored shipping solutions and high-quality services. As part of our continued organizational growth, we are currently looking for a Sales Specialist to join our fast-growing and challenging organization.

The Sales Specialist is responsible for supporting commercial activities, managing customer portfolios, and driving business growth through effective quotation management and customer relationship development. This role works closely with Inside Sales and Outside Sales teams to identify business opportunities, promote CMA CGM Group services and non-maritime products, and ensure customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate will leverage strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and market knowledge to support sales performance and contribute to the achievement of business objectives.

Strong account and portfolio management skills.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of customer needs and market dynamics.
Ability to identify business opportunities and contribute to sales growth.
Proficiency in MS Office and relevant commercial systems and applications.
